lines.text: Chin up, tomorrow will be better.

data.define: Used to encourage someone who is sad.

example.text: Chin up, tomorrow will be better.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chin up' to someone crying hard.

data.l1_hook: Hôm nay tệ, nhưng mai tới rồi!
data.l1_ex: Chin up, mai sẽ tốt hơn thôi.

native.tip: “chin up” = Cố lên nào. Ví dụ: “Chin up, tomorrow will be better.”
native.caption:
“chin up” nghĩa là gì?
“chin up” = Cố lên nào.
Ví dụ: “Chin up, tomorrow will be better.” (Chin up, mai sẽ tốt hơn thôi.)
